zones.label: Goal
zones.summary: Define the health problem, desired outcome, population, and decision authority.
facts: Include affected communities in defining success.

zones.label: Evidence
zones.summary: Assess quality, relevance, uncertainty, feasibility, and alternatives.
facts: Evidence includes research and lived experience.
Avoid claiming more than the data support.

zones.label: Who Benefits
zones.summary: Examine how benefits and burdens are distributed across groups and places.

zones.label: Possible Harms
zones.summary: Anticipate stigma, exclusion, privacy loss, cost, displacement, or unintended behavior.
facts: A good goal does not guarantee a harmless method.
Use the least restrictive effective approach.

zones.label: Revise and Monitor
zones.summary: Track implementation, outcomes, equity, and unintended effects over time.
facts: Revise or stop policies that cause avoidable harm.
